description: CASEWORK-B10 C4's edit (casework.md): V3021 -> V3621, one box's width: the vanity Y 186..150 and the VDB1521 moved to Y 150..135, 0.75 clear of P2's board at Y 134.25; every other panel of the VDB as c4-vanity-b10-p1's, moved 6 along the run. 6 452.42578125 in^3. model.json is the plugin's expansion with the member materials documents applies; members.json each body's member metadata (packages/loft-plugins/tests/test_casework_b10.py pins both).
derivation: Every expectation is ANALYTIC, from services/geometry/tests/test_casework_b10.py's independent script (test_casework's script of casework.md's conventions, never the plugin): each panel a box, a notched side its box less its 3 x 4.5 toe notch; summed in exact rational arithmetic (x 25.4 = mm exactly).
surface_area = each panel's box area, a notched side's less twice its notch's face; bodies are separate.
topology: a box 6 faces, 12 edges, 1 shell; a notched side 8 faces, 18 edges. MESH: a box 24 vertices and 12 triangles, a notched side 36 and 20 (two hexagons of 4 triangles, six quads of 2).
tolerance_rationale: Measured first, then set (geometry-gates skill), 2026-10-29: volume 3.7e-7 mm^3 and area 9.3e-9 mm^2 off the exact sums over 35 bodies, centroid 2.7e-12 mm; 1.5e-6 is 4x the worst.
roundtrip_tolerance_rationale: Measured 2026-10-29: the STEP round trip re-sums the 35 solids and moves the VOLUME by 2.1e-7 mm^3; 1e-6 is 4.8x; volume and area only.
